description_en: Queries driver channels in edge instances in batches
description_zh: 批量查询边缘实例中的驱动通道
name: BatchGetEdgeInstanceChannel

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. This parameter is not required for public instances, but is required for an Enterprise instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), move the pointer over the name of the target edge instance to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The driver ID. On the Drivers page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), move the pointer over the name of the target driver to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
驱动ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的驱动管理页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取
parameters.name: driver_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of driver channel IDs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/162253.html operation to obtain channel IDs.

You can specify up to 20 channel IDs in a single call
parameters.help_zh:
驱动通道ID列表。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/162253.html接口获取通道ID。

单次调用最多可填写20个通道ID
parameters.name: channel_ids

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates that the call was successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates that the call was successful. A value of false indicates that the call failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
